description: A hot dog company can build two types of butcher shops, a small shop and a large shop. A small shop can make 30 hot dogs per day and requires 2 workers. A large shop can make 70 hot dogs per day and requires 4 workers. The company must make at least 500 hot dogs per day but they only have available 30 workers. How many of each butcher shop should the company build to minimize the total number of butcher shops?

HotDogsPerSmallShop.definition: Number of hot dogs produced per small shop per day

WorkersPerSmallShop.definition: Number of workers required for a small shop

HotDogsPerLargeShop.definition: Number of hot dogs produced per large shop per day

WorkersPerLargeShop.definition: Number of workers required for a large shop

MinimumHotDogsPerDay.definition: Minimum number of hot dogs to be produced per day

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of butcher shops (small and large) built"

constraints.description: The total number of hot dogs produced by small and large shops per day must be at least MinimumHotDogsPerDay
The total number of workers required by small and large shops must not exceed AvailableWorkers
The numbers of small shops and large shops built must be non-negative integers

SmallShops.definition: Number of small butcher shops to build

LargeShops.definition: Number of large butcher shops to build
